aboutHeading: Macleod's Local Handyman for All Repairs
aboutText: Burston Handyman Services has been proudly serving Macleod and the North Eastern suburbs of Melbourne for over 10 years. Specialising in a wide range of repairs and maintenance, from carpentry to general handyman tasks, we ensure quality workmanship every time. Contact Russ on 0418 364 701 for a free quote today.
servicesText: From minor repairs to major renovations, Burston Handyman Services covers it all. We specialise in carpentry, painting, plumbing, and general maintenance to keep your home or business in top condition.

services.title: Carpentry & Woodwork
services.desc: Custom shelving, deck repairs, and door installations tailored to your home in Macleod.

services.title: Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Interior and exterior painting with attention to detail for a fresh, vibrant finish.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Fixing leaks, taps, and minor plumbing issues to prevent water damage in your property.

services.title: Electrical Fixes
services.desc: Safe and efficient light fixture replacements and socket repairs for your convenience.

services.title: General Maintenance
services.desc: Routine upkeep like gutter cleaning and fence repairs to maintain your home's value.
